product.name: Golpo AI
product.description: A cloud-based AI video creation platform that converts prompts, scripts, documents, and other source materials into narrated whiteboard or illustrated explainer videos.

product.name: Golpo AI for Jira
product.description: An Atlassian Marketplace app that converts Jira issues, sprint summaries, releases, and project content into narrated whiteboard videos.

product.name: Golpo AI for Confluence
product.description: An Atlassian Marketplace app that turns Confluence pages or selected text into narrated whiteboard videos and embeds the results inline.

product.name: Golpo AI API
product.description: A programmatic interface for generating Golpo narrated explainer videos from documents, prompts, and other content inputs at scale.
